remarks: All 8 verified sources are pages/files under the single official domain labour.delhi.gov.in (Office of the Labour Commissioner, Government of NCT of Delhi, Directorate of Industrial Safety & Health), which is the authoritative department for Factory License (FAL) in Delhi under the Delhi Factories Rules, 1950.

The actual transactional application portal (e-District Delhi, edistrict.delhigovt.nic.in) and the Factories Act, 1948 text itself were identified as the authoritative next steps but could not be fetched this session due to TLS connection resets through the proxy; this is noted honestly in 'excluded' rather than guessed at.

A Delhi-specific state single-window / EoDB portal (distinct from the national NSWS at nsws.gov.in) was reported in secondary news coverage as being built/planned, but no live, directly-relevant Delhi-specific URL for it surfaced in search results, so it was not pursued as a candidate this session.

A separate MCD (Municipal Corporation of Delhi) factory-licence/building-plan-approval requirement exists alongside the Labour Department's Factories Act licence (confirmed by the official FAQ PDF, Q6, and by the list-online-services page item 18); its site (mcdonline.gov.in) could not be verified this session (see 'excluded').

A draft 'Delhi Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Rules, 2025' intended to eventually replace the Delhi Factories Rules, 1950 was mentioned in secondary sources but no official gov.in text of it was found and verified this session, so it is omitted entirely from this list rather than included unverified.

The scratchpad 'checks' working directory used for initial curl output files is shared across sibling sessions compiling other states' lists in this pilot; this was noticed mid-task (unrelated states' content, e.g. Manipur, appeared in that directory from other sessions' fetches) and had no effect on this file's content — every URL listed above was independently fetched and inspected by this session, and later checks were moved to a session-private 'dl_checks' subdirectory out of caution.
